gold: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude -> Nilte am bewoju in gulamya or servimusiya
note: legal shall is a third-person directive (jussive am), not a future; a shall that opens a relative clause stays xa ("a world in which human beings shall enjoy freedom" -> xa befuraha)

gold: Whereas recognition of the inherent dignity ... -> Fe kolyo ki swikara ...
note: recital Whereas (capitalised, opening a clause) = considering that (word list: fe kolyo ki); contrastive whereas stays fe kompara ki in every register. The UDHR gold's Fe folo ki is a mistake (user)
